Usage: lasm init <directory> [--template plain|express|hono|fastify|std-http|web|fetch|fullstack] [--deploy TARGET]…

Creates a Lean project for Lasm: lakefile, lean-toolchain, package.json,
Main.lean, README.md, Dockerfile, .dockerignore and .gitignore.
The directory must be new or empty. The default template is plain.
--deploy (repeatable; server templates, and wasi for plain too) adds a target's files and
npm scripts (build:<target> runs lasm build --target <target>). Lasm never
installs or starts a platform's own tools; use the platform's CLI for that:
  lambda       AWS Lambda container image (Dockerfile.lambda, AWS Lambda Web Adapter)
  lambda-zip   AWS Lambda .zip for nodejs24.x (npm run build:lambda)
  lambda-edge  Lambda@Edge .zip for CloudFront origin requests (npm run build:lambda-edge)
  vercel       Vercel Function (vercel.json; Vercel runs the build)
  netlify      Netlify Function (netlify.toml; Netlify runs the build)
  azure        Azure Functions app (npm run build:azure)
  gcf          Google Cloud Functions gen2 (npm run build:gcf)
  workers      Cloudflare Workers (wrangler.toml; npm run build:workers, then npx wrangler dev)
  vercel-edge  Vercel Edge Function (vercel.json; Vercel runs npm run build:vercel-edge)
  netlify-edge Netlify Edge Function (netlify.toml; Netlify runs npm run build:netlify-edge)
  deno-deploy  Deno Deploy (npm run build:deno-deploy, then deno task start:deno; entrypoint deno/main.mjs)
  supabase-edge Supabase Edge Function (supabase/config.toml; npm run build:supabase-edge, then npx supabase functions deploy NAME)
  fastly       Fastly Compute (fastly.toml; npm run build:fastly, then fastly compute serve)
  wasi         a WASI module (npm run build:wasi writes wasi/main.wasm; wasmtime run --dir . wasi/main.wasm)
  wasi-http    a wasi-http component (npm run build:wasi-http writes wasi-http/main.wasm; wasmtime serve wasi-http/main.wasm)
  spin         Fermyon Spin (spin.toml; npm run build:wasi-http, then spin up)

Templates:
  plain     a Lean program (IO only)
  express   Express 5 with Lean request handlers (Lasm.JS)
  hono      Hono on @hono/node-server with Lean request handlers (Lasm.JS)
  fastify   Fastify 5 with Lean route handlers (Lasm.JS)
  std-http  an HTTP server in pure Lean (Std.Http)
  web       a browser app in Lean (Lasm.UI): a counter
  fetch     an HTTP handler on the web's Request and Response (Lasm.JS.Web) for Node, the edge, Bun and Deno, and on Fastly Compute, WASI and Spin through their own interfaces
  fullstack a full-stack Lean app: shared API and validation (Lasm.RPC), a server that renders the first page, a browser app (Lasm.UI) that hydrates it; Node, Workers, Bun, Deno, and every edge --deploy target

Example: npx @lasm/cli init my-app --template hono
